paths.description: Sensitive endpoints, prefix match without query string. Default [/wp-login.php, /xmlrpc.php].

min_distinct_ips.description: Distinct IPs per fingerprint (UA+method+endpoint) to flag a campaign. Default 20.

min_requests.description: Requests per fingerprint to flag a campaign. Default 30.

hot_secs.description: How long a flagged campaign stays hot after its last hit. Default 21600.

ignore_user_agents.description: Case-insensitive UA substrings never counted. Replaces the default list.

extra_ignore_user_agents.description: Appended to ignore_user_agents (or to the defaults).

ignore_redirects.description: Skip 3xx responses (successful WordPress login = 302). Default true.

vhost_min_distinct_ips.description: Second key per (vhost, endpoint) regardless of UA; 0 = off (default). Needs the trailing "$host" field in the nginx log.

retro_ban.description: Also ban IPs seen before the campaign was flagged. Default true.

max_retro_bans.description: Max retro bans per campaign trigger. Default 2000.

retro_batch.description: Max retro bans emitted per processed event (pipeline smoothing). Default 32.

max_hits_per_key.description: Max remembered hits per fingerprint. Default 4096.
